evidence.requirements: Every brief item is met. Start page shows title, date and time, "EUR n per guest" and "<n> seats left" (TastingCard.tsx:22,40-46; start.jpg). "Book <title>" links open the form (TastingCard.tsx:55-57). The form has Name, Email and Guests 1–8 fields and a "Book" button (BookingPage.tsx:153-178). Field errors appear next to their field (Field.tsx:35-40; form.jpg). Seat limit is enforced on the server (store.ts:88-91). The confirmation has the heading "Booking confirmed", the tasting, guests, total price and reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:41-54; confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and "Sign in" button, and the password comes from STAFF_PASSWORD (StaffPage.tsx:70-79, index.ts:6). Staff see bookings grouped by tasting with name, email, guests and reference, and "Cancel" frees seats (app.ts:130-154; staff.jpg). Fully booked and closed states exist (TastingCard.tsx:10-17). React with Express, React Router, react-hook-form, zod and Tailwind. PORT defaults to 3000, the app starts with no bookings, and the UI is in English. One soft point: a fully booked tasting hides its "Book <title>" link instead of disabling it. That is a reasonable reading of "clear state for fully booked".
evidence.correctness: The seat check and insert are synchronous with no await between them (store.ts:81-112). Tests send 10 parallel requests and get exactly 2 successes (api.test.ts:99-110). Exact-remaining and full cases return distinct codes (store.ts:90-91). Cancelled bookings are excluded from seat counts (store.ts:130), and a second cancel returns 404 without freeing seats twice (staff.test.ts:128-135). Guests are parsed strictly as whole numbers 1–8, rejecting 2.5, "abc", null and 100 (booking.ts:6-15; api.test.ts:62). Name and email are trimmed with max lengths. Unknown or __proto__ tasting IDs return 404. Booking closes once the start time passes in Europe/Berlin (tastings.ts:38-45). A failed file write rolls back the booking (store.ts:105-110). On the client, a double-click guard and a tasting that fills while the form is open are both handled (BookingPage.tsx:24-31,112-117). No logic defects found.
evidence.security: React escapes all output, with no dangerouslySetInnerHTML; an e2e test confirms guest text renders literally (booking.spec.ts:132-138). The password check compares SHA-256 digests with timingSafeEqual and rejects an empty or unset STAFF_PASSWORD (sessions.ts:6-11). Sessions use 32 random bytes, are server-side, expire after 8 h idle and are destroyed on logout (sessions.ts:13-47). The cookie is httpOnly with SameSite=Strict, and Secure via TRUST_PROXY (app.ts:104-109). Login is rate-limited (app.ts:90-97). helmet sets CSP, the JSON body limit is 8 kb, and API responses are no-store. The bookings file is mode 0600. No secrets are in the code, and a test confirms the password never reaches the logs (staff.test.ts:146-156).
evidence.code_quality: Clear split: shared/ holds the zod schema and tasting data used by client and server, server/ holds store, sessions and app, and src/ holds pages and components. The server uses typed result unions (store.ts:30-33). Error handling is consistent: field errors map 1:1 to form fields (app.ts:27-28, BookingPage.tsx:96-106). Components are small and reusable (Field, Notice, SeatsBadge). Naming is precise and comments are sparse and useful. The only slightly intricate spot is the shownFor state in BookingPage.tsx:24-31, which is documented.
evidence.tests: Tests cover every layer. Store tests cover seat accounting, the exact-fit boundary, full, closed, references and cancellation. API tests (Supertest) cover validation per field, the seat limit, 409 when full, concurrency, malformed JSON and 413. Staff tests cover the cookie flags, wrong, empty or unset password, rate limiting, idle expiry, logout, grouping, and cancel freeing seats. Persistence tests cover restart, corrupt files and rollback, and static tests cover the SPA fallback. Component tests cover each page, including server errors, network failure and the double-submit guard. Playwright e2e covers the full guest and staff flow, a 375 px phone viewport and axe WCAG AA checks (booking.spec.ts:147-209). test-results/.last-run.json shows passed.
evidence.ux_design: start.jpg: a clear hero with a short welcome, three cards with weekday kicker, date, price, a green seats badge and a prominent "Book …" button. form.jpg: the inline error has an icon and red border, the hint reads "Between 1 and 8 · 10 seats left", a live total shows the price, and "You pay at the winery" sets expectations. confirmation.jpg: a green check heading and a tidy summary list with the reference in monospace. staff.jpg: bookings are grouped under gold-ruled headings with seat counts and an empty state. Fully booked and closed states have dedicated badges and an explanatory page.
evidence.accessibility: Every input has a label via useId (Field.tsx:13-21). Errors set aria-invalid and aria-describedby, and react-hook-form moves focus to the first invalid field. Notices use role=alert or status (Notice.tsx:16). There is a skip link (Layout.tsx:7), landmark nav, aria-labelledby on articles and sections, sr-only dt labels, and time elements. A gold focus-visible outline is visible in form.jpg. Touch targets are at least 44 px and input text is 16 px. Axe WCAG 2.1 AA checks pass in e2e. Palette contrast looks sufficient (muted #66544f on cream).
evidence.simplicity: Dependencies match the brief's request for established libraries (Express, React Router, TanStack Query, react-hook-form, zod, Tailwind, helmet, express-rate-limit), with no needless abstraction. The app goes somewhat beyond the brief with optional file persistence (fsync, atomic rename), TRUST_PROXY handling and session idle expiry. These are well done but add code the brief did not ask for.
evidence.maintainability: The README has run, test and env-var instructions, a page map, a code layout and behavior notes (README.md). package-lock.json is present, and the typecheck and test scripts are clear. Regression tests are extensive. Gaps: no CI pipeline config, no changelog or release approach, and engines is ">=22" with no .nvmrc. The README says openspec/ holds the spec, design and task list, but openspec/specs contains only .gitkeep, so the decision docs are missing. There is no separate staff manual, though the staff flow is simple.
evidence.visual_design: A coherent winery palette: deep wine header with a gold rule, cream background, Fraunces serif headings and system sans body text (index.css:4-25). Cards, buttons and badges are consistent across all four screenshots. The success state uses green and errors use red with icons. It looks finished and on-brand.
evidence.layout: The hierarchy is clear: the h1 and intro come first, then a 3-column card grid on desktop that collapses on mobile (TastingsPage.tsx:31). The form and confirmation sit in a centred max-w-xl column. On the staff page, the title and Sign out share a row and sections are clearly grouped. No overlap or clipping appears in any screenshot, and e2e checks for no horizontal overflow at 375 px.
evidence.usability: Guests book in two steps (Book → form → confirmation), with a live total and hints showing the seat limit. Errors are specific ("Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.") and typed values are kept. The confirmation reloads safely. Staff sign in and cancel with a success notice. Weakness: "Cancel" acts immediately, with no confirmation or undo (StaffPage.tsx:168-179), so a mis-tap irreversibly cancels a guest's booking. The staff entry is only a small footer link, which is acceptable.
evidence.reception: It looks like a small winery's own polished site: warm palette, serif branding and friendly copy ("Join us in the cellar…"). The payment note builds trust. Guests would feel confident booking, and staff get a clean overview. Nothing looks amateurish.

strengths: Robust, well-tested booking logic: synchronous seat check and insert with a proven concurrency test, strict validation shared between client and server, field-level server errors and correct seat release on cancel.
Strong security: timing-safe password comparison, random server-side sessions with idle expiry, httpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, login rate limit, helmet CSP and no secrets in code.
Polished, accessible winery look across all pages, with clear fully booked, closed, error and success states, verified by axe and phone-viewport e2e tests.
issues: Staff "Cancel" fires immediately with no confirmation or undo (StaffPage.tsx:168-179), so one mis-tap irreversibly cancels a guest's booking.

Maintainability gaps: no CI pipeline, no release or changelog approach, unpinned Node version (engines ">=22", no .nvmrc), and the README says openspec/ holds the specs although openspec/specs contains only .gitkeep.

Scope beyond the brief (file persistence with fsync and atomic rename, TRUST_PROXY handling) adds code and configuration a small winery does not need; also, a fully booked tasting hides its "Book <title>" link instead of showing it disabled.
review.verdict: The app meets every requirement in the brief with correct, concurrency-safe logic, strong security and an unusually thorough test suite, and it looks like a finished winery site. Before shipping, add a confirm step on staff cancellation and close the small documentation and CI gaps.
